overview: Voidstone Ascension is the vertical spine of Vex Thal.
details: Floating voidstone platforms, resonance lifts, and temporal stabilizers form the ascent toward the Resonance Core. Xi Thall guardians oversee the passage.
hooks: A resonance lift destabilizes, dropping platforms into the void.
Temporal stabilizers flicker, altering gravity along the ascent.
Voidborn ascendants gather near a floating platform.
Xi Thall guardians initiate a ritual to reinforce the ascent.
